visual_action: The video opens with the painting 'Washington Crossing the Delaware' by Emanuel Leutze, with overlaid text describing the purpose of the American presidency. It then cuts to a still, close-up photograph of Donald Trump wearing a red 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat and a white collared shirt.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A still photograph of Donald Trump is shown as the second and final image of the video.

cast.name: George Washington
cast.evidence: Depicted as the central figure in the painting 'Washington Crossing the Delaware' at the start of the video.

on_screen_text.text: The American presidency was established to lead the United States, protect democracy, and direct our military.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio in the video, only a music track.
audio_music: A continuous, upbeat electronic pop track ('Check It Out' by will.i.am) plays throughout the video. Its energetic and modern feel creates a jarring contrast with the serious, historical imagery.
editing_pacing: A simple slideshow consisting of a single hard cut between two still images.
cultural_references: The painting 'Washington Crossing the Delaware' by Emanuel Leutze
The song 'Check It Out' by will.i.am
central_claim: Donald Trump represents a failure to live up to the noble, founding purpose of the American presidency.
intended_effect: To frame Donald Trump as unworthy of the presidency by contrasting him with American historical ideals.
